purpose: Machine-readable Current runtime capability governance. This registry governs implementation rights only; it is not a corpus, route, Scope mapping, permission or Canon data authority.

flexsearch_uid_cache_table.right: FlexSearch may be used only for measured, small, already narrowed local lexical workloads. A persistent UID cache is optional and must not be introduced solely to preserve an engine.
flexsearch_uid_cache_table.notes: Prefer fixed database eligibility flags, numeric summaries and write-time validation where they reduce repeated corpus reads. Keep an index/cache only when measured performance demonstrates a benefit.

keyword_operations_flexsearch.right: Keyword classification may use FlexSearch or a database-backed numeric summary. Prefer compact fixed filters and validated write-time aggregates when they reduce repeated full-content reads.
keyword_operations_flexsearch.notes: Full corpus text should not be loaded repeatedly for page rendering. Use statistics_able and other fixed eligibility fields before any bounded analysis; migrate expensive recurring aggregates to validated numeric summaries.
